# Book of Known Spells

Every spell here is a Known spell — a fixed formula with documented parameters and Overflow effects. Improvised spells follow identical mechanics with their parameters set by the GM at the time of casting.

Spells are organized by Tier, then by Domain. A new Arcanist works from the Cantrip and Standard lists. Advanced and Superior spells are what the practice opens up over time.

## How to Read a Spell Entry

Every spell in this book follows the same format.

> **Lightning Bolt**
>
> *Lightning · TN 8 · TH 2 · Short · Offensive · Elemental*
>
> A direct bolt of electrical energy at a single target. In a city wired end to end, this spell has a way of finding more than it was aimed at.
>
> **Target:** 1 person or object
>
> **Effect:** SP Damage
>
> **Defending:** Dodge
>
> **1x —** Damage increases by \[X\], and the target is Shocked.
>
> **2x+ —** Damage increases, the target is Shocked, and cybernetic targets may be DeSynced.
>
> *Tags: EMP*

**Name and Glyphs.** What Arcanists call it, and what it is built from. Most spells draw on one Glyph; more complex spells chain several, sometimes across Domains.

**Tier.** Cantrip, Standard, Advanced, or Superior. Shorthand for the TN and TH that follow.

**TN and TH.** The Target Number (TN) and Threshold (TH) required for a spell to Manifest.

**Range.** Close, Short, Medium, Long, or Extreme, as used everywhere else in the game. Some entries list **Self**, **Touch**, or an area shape instead.

**Spell Type.** Offensive, Defensive, or Utility. It tells you what the spell is for.

**Damage Type.** Different spells apply damage in different ways, and armor may reduce it.

- **Physical** — armor applies. Something real was thrown at someone.

- **Elemental** — armor does not apply. Fire, cold, current.

- **Spirit** — armor does not apply. Decay, wrath, and spells that work on minds.

- **Aether** — armor does not apply. Raw unshaped force.

**Target.** Who or what the spell is impacting.

**Effect.** What the spell does when it Manifests.

**Defending.** How the spell is resisted.

- **Dodge** against spells aimed at specific targets

- **Scramble** against area effects, for ½ damage or avoid a Condition

- **Essence** check against anything reaching into a mind or body

**Overflow.** Each net Hit above TH generates 1x, and each explosion generates another. Add them and read the matching line. Most spells cap at **2x+**; entries that scale further say so.

**Tags.** Properties that matter outside the spell's own text.

- **AOE** — affects an area rather than specific targets

- **DoT** — damage over multiple rounds

- **EMP** — interacts with electronics and cyberware

- **Fire** — can ignite flammable material

- **Cold** — can freeze liquids and make surfaces treacherous

- **Concentration** — held rather than released; dice equal to its TH are set aside until you let go

- **Alch./Ench.** — no Evocation form; exists only as a Talisman or Artifact

# **Cantrips**

*TN 7 · TH 1*

A single net Hit is enough. The lower Target Number means more dice land, so a small pool still Manifests a Cantrip consistently. These are the spells an Arcanist reaches for when they need something to work.

## **Elements**

**Dart**

*Fire · TN 7 · TH 1 · Short · Offensive · Elemental*

A focused mote of incendiary energy hurled at a single target. The first spell most Arcanists learn to throw, and the one they keep throwing.

**Target:** 1 person or object

**Effect:** ½ SP Damage

**Defending:** Dodge

> **1x —** Full Spell Power damage.
>
> **2x+ —** Full Spell Power damage, and the target is Burning.

*Tags: Fire*

**Gust**

*Air · TN 7 · TH 1 · Short · Utility*

A short burst of wind directed at a target or object. No damage unless the environment makes the push dangerous — which, in NYTE City, it often is.

**Target:** 1 person or object

**Effect:** Push 1–2m

**Defending:** Dodge

> **1x —** Push distance increases by \[X\]m.
>
> **2x+ —** Push distance increases by \[X\]m, and the target is Prone.

**Kindle**

*Fire · TN 7 · TH 1 · Close · Utility*

A focused burst of heat, enough to catch paper, dry cloth, or spilled fuel. What it does to what it touches is a separate matter.

**Target:** 1 small combustible object

**Effect:** Ignites the target

**Defending:** None

> **1x —** Ignites moderately resistant materials.
>
> **2x+ —** Ignites multiple objects at once, or ignition is instantaneous rather than gradual.

*Tags: Fire*

**Sparks**

*Fire · TN 7 · TH 1 · Close · Offensive · Elemental*

A shower of sparks radiating outward. Enough to startle, not enough to matter unless something else catches.

**Target:** 1 person, or flammable objects in range

**Effect:** 1 Damage, and flammables ignite

**Defending:** Dodge

> **1x —** ½ Spell Power damage, or a significantly wider area ignited.
>
> **2x+ —** ½ Spell Power damage, and the target is Burning.

*Tags: Fire*

**Tremor**

*Earth · TN 7 · TH 1 · Short · Utility*

A focused vibration driven into a surface. Enough to startle, unbalance, or dislodge something poorly secured.

**Target:** An area of ground or a single surface

**Effect:** Difficult terrain in the affected area for 1 round

**Defending:** Scramble

> **1x —** Affected area increases by \[X\]m.
>
> **2x+ —** Affected area increases, and targets are Prone.

*Tags: AOE*

**Zap**

*Lightning · TN 7 · TH 1 · Short · Offensive · Elemental*

A focused arc of electrical energy. The caster chooses at time of casting whether to hurt someone or break something.

**Target:** 1 person or electronic device

**Effect:** ½ SP Damage, or shorts simple electronics

**Defending:** Dodge

> **1x —** Full Spell Power damage.
>
> **2x+ —** Full Spell Power damage, and cybernetic targets may be DeSynced.

*Tags: EMP*

## **Force**

**Push**

*Telekinesis · TN 7 · TH 1 · Short · Offensive · Physical*

Raw kinetic force exerted against a person, object, or door. No damage unless they hit something on the way.

**Target:** 1 person or object

**Effect:** Shove 2m

**Defending:** Dodge

> **1x —** Distance increases by \[X\]m.
>
> **2x+ —** Distance increases by \[X\]m, and the target is Prone.

**Shield**

*Barrier · TN 7 · TH 1 · Self / Touch · Defensive*

A barrier of shaped Aether. The most reliable defensive spell in the Force Domain, and the one most Arcanists master first.

**Target:** Self or 1 ally within reach

**Effect:** Absorbs SP damage of any type for 1 round

**Defending:** None

> **1x —** Absorbed damage increases by \[X\].
>
> **2x+ —** Absorbed damage increases by \[X\], and the barrier holds an additional round.

**Snatch**

*Telekinesis · TN 7 · TH 1 · Short · Utility*

Pulls a small object through the air and into the caster's hand. Useful for weapons, keys, and anything that has ended up somewhere inconvenient.

**Target:** 1 object of 5 lbs or less

**Effect:** Object is pulled to the caster

**Defending:** BOD Essence, if held

> **1x —** Weight limit increases by \[X\] lbs.
>
> **2x+ —** Weight limit increases, or two objects are pulled at once.

## **Matter**

**Crystal Shield**

*Glass · TN 7 · TH 1 · Self / Touch · Defensive*

A crystalline barrier, visible and physical, that shatters loudly when it fails.

**Target:** Self or 1 ally within reach

**Effect:** Absorbs SP damage of any type for 1 round

**Defending:** None

> **1x —** Absorbed damage increases by \[X\].
>
> **2x+ —** Absorbed damage increases, and shards deal \[X\] damage to adjacent attackers when the barrier breaks.

**Thorn Snare**

*Wood · TN 7 · TH 1 · 5m radius · Utility*

Forces growth from whatever organic material is present — roots through concrete, vines from a planter, something that was not there a moment ago.

**Target:** All targets in the area

**Effect:** Area becomes Difficult Terrain

**Defending:** Scramble

> **1x —** Radius increases by \[X\]m, or duration extends by \[X\] rounds.
>
> **2x+ —** Radius increases, and targets who fail are Restrained.

*Tags: AOE*

## **Mind**

**Glimmer**

*Illusion · TN 7 · TH 1 · Short · Utility*

A flash of light at the edge of a target's vision — bright enough to pull focus, brief enough to deny.

**Target:** 1 person

**Effect:** Target's next action takes \[X\] penalty

**Defending:** INT Essence

> **1x —** Duration extends by \[X\] round.
>
> **2x+ —** Duration extends, and the target is Disoriented.

**Hush**

*Illusion · TN 7 · TH 1 · 5m radius · Utility*

Sound dampened to almost nothing. Does not create silence. Creates deniability.

**Target:** An area

**Effect:** \[X\] bonus to Stealth within the area for 1 round

**Defending:** None

> **1x —** Radius increases by \[X\]m, or duration by \[X\] round.
>
> **2x+ —** Both, or silence rather than dampening.

*Tags: AOE*

**Sense**

*Insight · TN 7 · TH 1 · Self · Utility*

Heightened awareness for the space of a breath.

**Target:** Self

**Effect:** Detect one of: active magic, movement, or hostile intent

**Defending:** None

> **1x —** Duration or range increases by \[X\].
>
> **2x+ —** Two categories detected at once.

**True Sight**

*Insight · TN 7 · TH 1 · Self · Utility*

Perception sharpened past whatever is being used to obscure it.

**Target:** Self

**Effect:** Reveals hidden creatures, disguises, and invisibility

**Defending:** Contested against the concealing effect

> **1x —** Range or duration increases by \[X\].
>
> **2x+ —** Both, or extends to an additional sense.

**Veil of Shadows**

*Illusion · TN 7 · TH 1 · Self / Touch · Utility*

Ambient shadow drawn close. Not invisibility — something better suited to a city with this many corners.

**Target:** Self or 1 ally within reach

**Effect:** Target counts as Dark to observers, and gains \[X\] to Stealth

**Defending:** INT Essence to notice

> **1x —** Duration extends by \[X\] round.
>
> **2x+ —** Duration extends, or a second target is covered.

## **Soul**

**Luck of the Bold**

*Vitality · TN 7 · TH 1 · Self · Utility*

A surge of certainty ahead of a moment that needs it.

**Target:** Self

**Effect:** Bonus to next action equal to net Hits, used within 1 round

**Defending:** None

> **1x —** Bonus increases by \[X\].
>
> **2x+ —** Bonus increases, and the window extends by one action.

**Soothe**

*Vitality · TN 7 · TH 1 · Touch · Utility*

Slows the heart rate, clears the adrenaline fog, takes the edge off whatever they just saw.

**Target:** 1 person within reach

**Effect:** Negates fear-based penalties

**Defending:** WILL Essence, if unwilling

> **1x —** Duration extends by \[X\] round.
>
> **2x+ —** Duration extends, and a second target is affected.

# **Standard**

*TN 8 · TH 2*

The working core of any practice. Two net Hits is achievable with a moderate pool, but Duds start to matter. A bad roll here costs more than a bad roll at Cantrip.

## **Elements**

**Aero Scythe**

*Air · TN 8 · TH 2 · Short · Offensive · Physical*

A blade of compressed air. The trajectory is flat and fast — nothing visible until it arrives.

**Target:** 1 person or object

**Effect:** SP Damage

**Defending:** Dodge

> **1x —** Damage increases by \[X\].
>
> **2x+ —** Damage increases, and the target is Bleeding.

**Blazing Fury**

*Fire · TN 8 · TH 2 · 5m radius · Offensive · Elemental*

The air around a point ignites, engulfing everything in it while the Arcanist holds the shape.

**Target:** All targets in the area

**Effect:** ½ SP Damage each round the spell is held

**Defending:** Scramble, each round

> **1x —** Radius increases by \[X\]m.
>
> **2x+ —** Radius increases, and targets who fail are Burning.

*Tags: AOE, Fire, Concentration*

**Elemental Battery**

*Fire · Water · Lightning · TN 8 · TH 2 · Self · Defensive*

Elemental force caught and held rather than dispersed. Fire taken is fire returned.

**Target:** Self

**Effect:** Absorbs up to SP Elemental damage; discharges on the caster's next attack

**Defending:** None

> **1x —** Capacity increases by \[X\].
>
> **2x+ —** Capacity increases, and the charge can be released as its own attack rather than riding an existing one.

*Tags: Concentration*

**Firebolt**

*Fire · TN 8 · TH 2 · Short · Offensive · Elemental*

The workhorse of the Fire Glyph — straightforward, reliable, and exactly as dangerous as the die pool makes it.

**Target:** 1 person or object

**Effect:** SP Damage

**Defending:** Dodge

> **1x —** Damage increases by \[X\].
>
> **2x+ —** Damage increases, and the target is Burning.

*Tags: Fire*

**Fog Shroud**

*Water · TN 8 · TH 2 · 10m radius · Utility*

Ambient moisture condensed into a bank of fog thick enough to lose a firefight in.

**Target:** An area

**Effect:** Area counts as Dark; line of sight across it is broken

**Defending:** None

> **1x —** Radius increases by \[X\]m.
>
> **2x+ —** Radius increases, and the area counts as Blind rather than Dark.

*Tags: AOE, Concentration*

**Frostbite**

*Water · TN 8 · TH 2 · Short · Offensive · Elemental*

A sharp chill across exposed skin, joints, extremities.

**Target:** 1 person

**Effect:** ½ SP Damage, and the ground beneath them becomes Difficult Terrain

**Defending:** Dodge

> **1x —** Full Spell Power damage.
>
> **2x+ —** Full Spell Power damage, and the target is Restrained.

*Tags: Cold*

**Hydro Push**

*Water · TN 8 · TH 2 · 5m cone · Utility*

A directed wave. Good for crowd control, better for making a mess of a room that needed one.

**Target:** All targets in the cone

**Effect:** Push 1–2m; extinguishes small fires

**Defending:** Scramble

> **1x —** Push distance increases by \[X\]m.
>
> **2x+ —** Push distance increases, and targets are Prone.

*Tags: AOE*

**Ice Spear**

*Water · TN 8 · TH 2 · Short · Offensive · Physical*

A lance of solid ice formed and hurled in one motion. It shatters on impact, which is loud and hard to explain.

**Target:** 1 person or object

**Effect:** SP Damage

**Defending:** Dodge

> **1x —** Damage increases by \[X\].
>
> **2x+ —** Damage increases, and the target is Restrained.

*Tags: Cold*

**Ignite**

*Fire · TN 8 · TH 2 · Short · Offensive · Elemental*

Sets a target alight and leaves them to deal with it.

**Target:** 1 person or object

**Effect:** Target is Burning until extinguished

**Defending:** Dodge

> **1x —** Burning severity increases by one step.
>
> **2x+ —** Burning severity increases, and the fire spreads to an adjacent target.

*Tags: Fire, DoT*

**Inferno Burst**

*Fire · TN 8 · TH 2 · 5m radius · Offensive · Elemental*

A sudden detonation of heat radiating outward. Fire does not distinguish allies.

**Target:** All targets in the area

**Effect:** SP Damage

**Defending:** Scramble

> **1x —** Radius increases by \[X\]m.
>
> **2x+ —** Radius increases, and targets who fail are Burning.

*Tags: AOE, Fire*

**Lightning Bolt**

*Lightning · TN 8 · TH 2 · Short · Offensive · Elemental*

A direct bolt of electrical energy. In a city wired end to end, this spell has a way of finding more than it was aimed at.

**Target:** 1 person or object

**Effect:** SP Damage

**Defending:** Dodge

> **1x —** Damage increases by \[X\], and the target is Shocked.
>
> **2x+ —** Damage increases, the target is Shocked, and cybernetic targets may be DeSynced.

*Tags: EMP*

**Lightning Trap**

*Lightning · TN 8 · TH 2 · Proximity · Offensive · Elemental*

A discharge waiting in an object for someone to come too close. Has no Evocation form — the Aether will not hold this shape in open air.

**Target:** Designated target type entering range

**Effect:** SP Damage on trigger

**Defending:** Scramble

> **1x —** Damage or area increases at inscription.
>
> **2x+ —** Targets who fail are Shocked.

*Tags: EMP, Ench.*

**Quake**

*Earth · TN 8 · TH 2 · 10m radius · Utility*

A localized tremor, enough to destabilize structures and put people on the floor.

**Target:** All targets in the area

**Effect:** Targets are Prone; loose structures may collapse

**Defending:** Scramble

> **1x —** Radius increases by \[X\]m.
>
> **2x+ —** Radius increases, and the broken ground becomes Difficult Terrain.

*Tags: AOE*

**Shock**

*Lightning · TN 8 · TH 2 · Short · Offensive · Elemental*

A sharper, more focused jolt than Zap.

**Target:** 1 person or electronic device

**Effect:** SP Damage, or disrupts hardened electronics

**Defending:** Dodge

> **1x —** Damage increases by \[X\], and the target is Shocked.
>
> **2x+ —** Damage increases, and cybernetic targets may be DeSynced.

*Tags: EMP*

**Spark Trap**

*Lightning · TN 8 · TH 2 · Proximity · Offensive · Elemental*

A disorienting discharge set into an object. Has no Evocation form.

**Target:** Designated target type entering range

**Effect:** ½ SP Damage on trigger

**Defending:** Scramble

> **1x —** Additional triggers or wider area at inscription.
>
> **2x+ —** Targets who fail are Shocked or DeSynced.

*Tags: EMP, Ench.*

**Static Burst**

*Lightning · TN 8 · TH 2 · 5m radius · Offensive · Elemental*

An electromagnetic pulse radiating outward. Unaugmented targets feel nothing. Shielded housings take nothing either.

**Target:** Electronics and cyberware in the area

**Effect:** ½ SP Damage to electronics and cyberware

**Defending:** TECH Essence

> **1x —** Damage increases by \[X\].
>
> **2x+ —** Damage increases, and cybernetic targets are Shocked.

*Tags: AOE, EMP*

**Tidal Surge**

*Water · TN 8 · TH 2 · Short · Utility*

A wave surging outward. No direct damage — the utility is the point.

**Target:** All targets in the area

**Effect:** Push 1–2m; extinguishes fires and moves loose objects

**Defending:** Scramble

> **1x —** Push distance or area increases by \[X\]m.
>
> **2x+ —** Both, and targets are Prone.

*Tags: AOE*

**Water Breathing**

*Water · TN 8 · TH 2 · Touch · Utility*

No combat application whatsoever, and occasionally the only thing that matters.

**Target:** 1 willing person within reach

**Effect:** Target breathes underwater for \[X\] minutes

**Defending:** None

> **1x —** Duration extends by \[X\] minutes.
>
> **2x+ —** Duration extends, and a second target is affected.

**Wind Walker**

*Air · TN 8 · TH 2 · Self · Utility*

Moving air wrapped close, lightening the step and sharpening the reaction.

**Target:** Self

**Effect:** MOB increases by \[X\]; \[X\] bonus to Dodge

**Defending:** None

> **1x —** Duration extends by \[X\] round.
>
> **2x+ —** MOB and Dodge bonuses each increase by \[X\].

*Tags: Concentration*

## **Force**

**Arc Lash**

*Shockwave · TN 8 · TH 2 · Short · Offensive · Aether*

A whip of raw Aether. Leaves a mark that does not look like anything conventional made it.

**Target:** 1 person or object

**Effect:** SP Damage

**Defending:** Dodge

> **1x —** Damage or range increases by \[X\].
>
> **2x+ —** Damage increases, and the target is Disarmed.

**Crush**

*Telekinesis · TN 8 · TH 2 · Short · Offensive · Physical*

A nearby object seized and slammed home at speed. What is available shapes what the damage looks like afterward.

**Target:** 1 person

**Effect:** SP Damage

**Defending:** Dodge

> **1x —** Damage or knockback increases by \[X\].
>
> **2x+ —** Damage increases, and the target is Prone.

**Feather Fall**

*Gravity · TN 8 · TH 2 · Short · Utility*

A descent slowed to survivable speed. Can be cast on someone else mid-fall, which is a specific kind of rescue and requires seeing it happen.

**Target:** 1 falling person or object

**Effect:** Negates falling damage and the Prone that follows

**Defending:** None

> **1x —** Radius extends to cover additional falling targets.
>
> **2x+ —** Radius extends, and duration covers a longer descent.

**Force Armor**

*Barrier · TN 8 · TH 2 · Self / Touch · Defensive*

A layered barrier that scales with the quality of the cast rather than a flat value.

**Target:** Self or 1 ally within reach

**Effect:** Absorbs SP + net Hits damage of any type for 1 round

**Defending:** None

> **1x —** Absorbed damage increases by \[X\].
>
> **2x+ —** Absorbed damage increases, and the barrier holds an additional round.

**Force Burst**

*Shockwave · TN 8 · TH 2 · 3m radius · Offensive · Physical*

Concussive energy radiating outward from the caster.

**Target:** All targets in the area

**Effect:** SP Damage, or push all targets outward

**Defending:** Scramble

> **1x —** Radius increases by \[X\]m.
>
> **2x+ —** Radius increases, and targets are Prone.

*Tags: AOE*

**Kinetic Ward**

*Barrier · TN 8 · TH 2 · Self / Touch · Defensive*

A barrier tuned against impact and nothing else. The Arcanist who knows a firefight is coming reaches for this instead of Shield.

**Target:** Self or 1 ally within reach

**Effect:** Absorbs SP × 2 Physical damage for 1 round

**Defending:** None

> **1x —** Absorbed damage increases by \[X\].
>
> **2x+ —** Absorbed damage increases, and the ward holds an additional round.

**Repel**

*Shockwave · TN 8 · TH 2 · 5m cone · Utility*

A concussive blast that shoves targets back and rattles them badly.

**Target:** All targets in the cone

**Effect:** Push 1–2m

**Defending:** Scramble

> **1x —** Push distance increases by \[X\]m.
>
> **2x+ —** Push distance increases, and targets are Disoriented.

*Tags: AOE*

**Spatial Warp**

*Distortion · TN 8 · TH 2 · Short · Utility*

Local space bent to alter how things move through it. A corridor made longer, a doorway made harder to reach than it looks.

**Target:** An area or 1 projectile in flight

**Effect:** Alters movement or trajectory; effects negotiated with the GM

**Defending:** Dodge, where applicable

> **1x —** Affected area or complexity increases.
>
> **2x+ —** Both, or duration extends by \[X\] round.

*Tags: Concentration*

## **Matter**

**Earthen Shield**

*Stone · TN 8 · TH 2 · Self / Touch · Defensive*

Hardened earth or concrete pulled up into a wall. Leaves debris behind when it drops.

**Target:** Self or 1 ally within reach

**Effect:** Grants Heavy Cover; Integrity \[X\]

**Defending:** None

> **1x —** Integrity increases by \[X\].
>
> **2x+ —** Integrity increases, and the barrier covers an additional target.

**Facemask**

*Flesh · TN 8 · TH 2 · Touch · Utility*

Not a disguise in the conventional sense — the face is genuinely different. Fools cameras, fools people, does not fool gait analysis or a TAG scan.

**Target:** 1 person within reach

**Effect:** Target's facial features are reshaped

**Defending:** WILL Essence, if unwilling

> **1x —** Realism improves, or the change holds without active concentration.
>
> **2x+ —** Both, or gestures and vocal patterns are mimicked as well.

*Tags: Concentration*

**Iron Lance**

*Metal · TN 8 · TH 2 · Short · Offensive · Physical*

A lance of solid metal formed and driven home.

**Target:** 1 person or object

**Effect:** SP Damage, armor piercing

**Defending:** Dodge

> **1x —** Range or armor penetration increases by \[X\].
>
> **2x+ —** Both, and the target is Bleeding.

*Tags: AP*

**Mend Flesh**

*Flesh · TN 8 · TH 2 · Touch · Utility*

Tissue knitted back together. Sovereign Soul applies.

**Target:** 1 person within reach

**Effect:** Restores 1d SP Health Levels

**Defending:** WILL Essence, if unwilling

> **1x —** Healing increases by \[X\].
>
> **2x+ —** Healing increases, and the target resists damage for \[X\] rounds.

**Staunch**

*Flesh · TN 8 · TH 2 · Touch · Utility*

Seals what is open and smothers what is burning. Handles what the source left behind, not the source. Sovereign Soul applies.

**Target:** 1 person within reach

**Effect:** Ends Bleeding, Burning, or Shocked

**Defending:** WILL Essence, if unwilling

> **1x —** A second ongoing condition ends.
>
> **2x+ —** All ongoing damage conditions end, and \[X\] Health Levels are restored.

**Stone Lash**

*Stone · TN 8 · TH 2 · Short · Offensive · Physical*

Loose debris animated and whipped outward. Requires debris to be present, which in most of NYTE City is not a constraint.

**Target:** 1 person or object

**Effect:** SP Damage

**Defending:** Dodge

> **1x —** Knockback added, or a second minor target struck.
>
> **2x+ —** Damage increases, and the target is Prone.

**Stone Skin**

*Stone · TN 8 · TH 2 · Self / Touch · Defensive*

Skin hardened to the density of stone. Movement is unaffected, which is the part that takes practice.

**Target:** Self or 1 ally within reach

**Effect:** Absorbs SP damage of any type for 1 round

**Defending:** None

> **1x —** Absorbed damage increases by \[X\].
>
> **2x+ —** Absorbed damage increases, and the effect holds an additional round.

**Stone Spike**

*Stone · TN 8 · TH 2 · Short · Offensive · Physical*

A jagged spike driven up through the ground. Requires the target to be standing on something the spell can work with.

**Target:** 1 person

**Effect:** SP Damage

**Defending:** Dodge

> **1x —** Damage increases by \[X\], or knockback added.
>
> **2x+ —** Damage increases, and the target is Restrained — the spike pins rather than pierces clean.

## **Mind**

Single word, single action, no complexity. The target knows it happened.

**Effect:** Target performs one simple action on their next turn

>

Psychic terror radiating outward. A wrongness nobody can source and a strong urge to be elsewhere.

**Defending:** WILL Essence

> **1x —** Radius or duration increases by \[X\].
>
> **2x+ —** Radius increases, and targets are Frightened.

**Flashbang**

Functionally identical to the ordnance it is named after, minus the ordnance.

**Target:** An area

**Effect:** Area counts as Blind for 1 round

**Defending:** Scramble

> **1x —** Duration or radius increases by \[X\].
>
> **2x+ —** Duration increases, and targets who fail are Blinded.

*Tags: AOE*

**Mind Nudge**

*Compulsion · TN 8 · TH 2 · Short · Offensive · Spirit*

A light push against a target's attention. Not control — just interference.

>
> **2x+ —** Duration extends, and the target is Disoriented.

**Rewrite Memory**

*Memory · TN 8 · TH 2 · Touch · Utility · Spirit*

A few minutes rewritten, a face swapped out. It holds under casual recall and frays under pressure. The target almost always knows something happened, even when they cannot say what. Sovereign Soul applies.

**Target:** 1 person within reach

**Effect:** Alters a brief, recent memory

**Defending:** WILL Essence

> **1x —** Clarity of the implanted memory improves, or the window altered extends.
>
> **2x+ —** Both, or corroborating detail is implanted alongside it.

## **Soul**

**Cleanse**

*Vitality · TN 8 · TH 2 · Touch · Utility*

An affliction drawn out and dispersed. Does not reach what the body has already accepted as permanent. Sovereign Soul applies.

**Target:** 1 person within reach

**Effect:** Removes Bleeding, Blinded, Deafened, Disoriented, Frightened, or Poisoned

**Defending:** WILL Essence, if unwilling

> **1x —** A second condition is removed.
>
> **2x+ —** A second condition is removed, and the target resists reacquiring it this scene.

**Counterspell**\
Decay · TN 8 · Short · Utility

You attempt to unravel the Aether another caster is still gathering. Nothing about a charged spell wants to hold together, and you’re helping to rip it apart.

**Target:** 1 creature charging a spell, within line of sight\
**Effect:** If successful, the spell is dispersed and the caster loses their progress.\
**Defending:** Opposed Spellcraft (Evocation) check

Counterspell has no Threshold and no Overflow.

**Decay Burst**

*Decay · TN 8 · TH 2 · Short · Offensive · Spirit*

Decay accelerated through cloth, plate, and casing alike. The Aether does not respect material science.

**Target:** 1 person's worn or carried gear

**Effect:** Strips \[X\] Integrity from armor or equipment

**Defending:** BOD Essence

> **1x —** Integrity stripped increases by \[X\], or a second item is affected.
>
> **2x+ —** Both, or the affected item is destroyed outright.

**Soul Anchor**

*Binding · TN 8 · TH 2 · Touch · Utility*

A significant working with significant implications, and one that should be entered into deliberately. Sovereign Soul applies.

**Target:** 1 person within reach

**Effect:** Prevents astral travel, possession, or departure at death

**Defending:** WILL Essence, if unwilling

> **1x —** Duration extends significantly.
>
> **2x+ —** Duration extends, and a second anchor point is established.

**Spirit Ward**

*Spirit · TN 8 · TH 2 · Self / Touch · Defensive*

A spirit anchored against intrusion. Does not stop physical harm. Stops the other thing.

**Target:** Self or 1 ally within reach

**Effect:** Absorbs SP × 2 Spirit damage; resists possession and compulsion

**Defending:** None

> **1x —** Absorbed damage increases by \[X\].
>
> **2x+ —** Absorbed damage increases, and the ward holds an additional round.

**Wither**

*Decay · TN 8 · TH 2 · Short · Offensive · Spirit*

Vitality drawn straight out. The damage does not look like an injury. It looks like time.

**Target:** 1 person

**Effect:** SP Damage

**Defending:** BOD Essence

> **1x —** Damage increases by \[X\].
>
> **2x+ —** Damage increases, and the target is Agonized.

**Wrathful Smite**

*Wrath · TN 8 · TH 2 · Touch · Offensive · Spirit*

Spiritual fury poured into a weapon. The energy discharges on contact whether the strike lands well or badly.

**Target:** 1 weapon or the caster's own hands

**Effect:** Adds SP Damage to the next successful attack

**Defending:** None to imbue; the attack resolves normally

> **1x —** Bonus damage increases by \[X\].
>
> **2x+ —** Bonus damage increases, and the target is Agonized.

# **Advanced**

*TN 8 · TH 3*

Three net Hits requires either enough dice to absorb some Duds or enough control to avoid them. Advanced spells reward the Arcanist who has invested in rank.

## **Elements**

**Chain Lightning**

*Lightning · TN 8 · TH 3 · Short · Offensive · Elemental*

A bolt that strikes and then keeps going. Bringing more dice to this roll is not just about landing it. It is about how many people it reaches when it does.

**Target:** 1 person, then additional targets within 2m of the last

**Effect:** SP Damage to each target struck

**Defending:** Dodge on the initial target; Scramble for each arc

> **1x —** Arcs to one additional target.
>
> **2x —** Arcs to two additional targets, and all targets hit are Shocked.
>
> **3x —** Arcs to three additional targets, and cybernetic targets may be DeSynced.

*Tags: AOE, EMP*

**Fireball**

*Fire · TN 8 · TH 3 · 3m radius · Offensive · Elemental*

A ball of flame thrown to a point and detonating on arrival. The radius is unforgiving and fire does not distinguish allies.

**Target:** All targets in the area

**Effect:** SP Damage

**Defending:** Scramble

> **1x —** Radius increases by \[X\]m.
>
> **2x+ —** Radius increases, and targets who fail are Burning.

*Tags: AOE, Fire*

**Frost Wall**

*Water · TN 8 · TH 3 · Short · Defensive*

A wall of ice raised along a line. Blocks line of sight and movement until destroyed or melted.

**Target:** A line up to 5m long

**Effect:** Grants Full Cover; Integrity \[X\]

**Defending:** None

> **1x —** Length or Integrity increases by \[X\].
>
> **2x+ —** Both, and the wall shatters outward when destroyed, dealing ½ SP Damage within \[X\]m.

*Tags: Cold*

**Ice Spike**

*Water · TN 8 · TH 3 · Short · Offensive · Physical*

The same damage as Ice Spear in a narrower, faster delivery, and it holds the target in place far more effectively.

**Target:** 1 person

**Effect:** SP Damage

**Defending:** Dodge

> **1x —** Damage increases by \[X\].
>
> **2x+ —** Damage increases, and the target is Restrained and Agonized.

*Tags: Cold*

## **Force**

**Aegis**

*Barrier · Distortion · TN 8 · TH 3 · Self / Touch · Defensive*

The expensive answer to not knowing what is coming.

**Target:** Self or 1 ally within reach

**Effect:** Absorbs SP × 2 damage of any type

**Defending:** None

> **1x —** Absorbed damage increases by \[X\].
>
> **2x+ —** Absorbed damage increases, and the barrier holds an additional round.

*Tags: Concentration*

**Arc Beam**

*Shockwave · TN 8 · TH 3 · Short · Offensive · Aether*

A beam of Aether sustained across rounds for as long as the Arcanist can hold it.

**Target:** All targets in a line

**Effect:** SP Damage per round held

**Defending:** Dodge, each round

> **1x —** Beam length or damage per round increases by \[X\].
>
> **2x+ —** Both, and targets are Agonized.

*Tags: Concentration*

**Telekinetic Shove**

*Telekinesis · TN 8 · TH 3 · Short · Offensive · Physical*

A wall of kinetic force driven down a line. Anything that hits something solid on the way takes the worse end of it.

**Target:** All targets in a line

**Effect:** Shove 1–3m; SP Damage on collision

**Defending:** Scramble

> **1x —** Shove distance increases by \[X\]m, or additional targets are caught.
>
> **2x+ —** Distance increases, and targets are Prone.

*Tags: AOE*

## **Matter**

**Boulder Slam**

*Stone · TN 8 · TH 3 · Short · Offensive · Physical*

A chunk of masonry, a vehicle panel, a section of wall. Requires something suitable to be present.

**Target:** 1 person

**Effect:** SP Damage

**Defending:** Dodge

> **1x —** Damage or knockback increases by \[X\].
>
> **2x+ —** Damage increases, and the target is Prone and Injured.

**Knit Bone**

*Flesh · TN 8 · TH 3 · Touch · Utility*

The fracture, the torn nerve, the joint that stopped answering. Takes the place of a week of downtime. Sovereign Soul applies.

**Target:** 1 person within reach

**Effect:** Removes the Injured condition

**Defending:** WILL Essence, if unwilling

> **1x —** \[X\] Health Levels are restored alongside the repair.
>
> **2x+ —** All Injured conditions are repaired, and \[X\] Health Levels are restored.

**Spike Trap**

*Stone · TN 8 · TH 3 · Proximity · Offensive · Physical*

A field of spikes waiting under the floor. Has no Evocation form — the shaping takes longer than a live cast allows.

**Target:** Designated target type entering the area

**Effect:** SP Damage on trigger

**Defending:** Scramble

> **1x —** Duration or area increases at inscription.
>
> **2x+ —** Targets who fail are Restrained.

*Tags: AOE, Ench.*

## **Mind**

**Blinding Flash**

*Fear · TN 8 · TH 3 · 10m radius · Offensive*

Brighter, broader, and harder to look away from than Flashbang.

**Target:** An area

**Effect:** Area counts as Blind for 1 round

**Defending:** Scramble

> **1x —** Duration or radius increases by \[X\].
>
> **2x+ —** Duration increases, and targets who fail are Blinded and Disoriented.

*Tags: AOE*

**Confuse**

*Compulsion · TN 8 · TH 3 · Short · Offensive · Spirit*

Directions invert, faces shift, the floor stops being reliable. The target acts on what they believe they are seeing.

**Target:** 1 person

**Effect:** Target's perception of their surroundings is distorted for 1–2 rounds

**Defending:** WILL Essence

> **1x —** Duration extends by \[X\] round.
>
> **2x+ —** Duration extends, the target is Disoriented, and may act against their own interests.

**Ember Sight**

*Insight · TN 8 · TH 3 · Self · Utility*

Vision pushed into the infrared. Does not see through walls — sees through the things people use to hide behind them.

**Target:** Self

**Effect:** Heat sources resolve through darkness, smoke, and thin barriers

**Defending:** None

> **1x —** Duration or range increases by \[X\].
>
> **2x+ —** Both, and residual heat can be tracked for \[X\] minutes after a target has left.

*Tags: Concentration*

**Mirror Image**

*Illusion · TN 8 · TH 3 · Self · Defensive*

Duplicates moving in imperfect synchrony with the original. Each one dissipates when hit.

**Target:** Self

**Effect:** 1–3 illusory duplicates; attacks may strike a duplicate instead

**Defending:** INT Essence to identify the original

> **1x —** One additional duplicate.
>
> **2x+ —** Additional duplicates, and they act independently for \[X\] rounds.

*Tags: Concentration*

## **Soul**

**Purge**

*Vitality · TN 8 · TH 3 · Touch · Utility*

A harder working than Cleanse, reaching what has set deeper. The Aether does not heal these so much as refuse them. Sovereign Soul applies.

**Target:** 1 person within reach

**Effect:** Removes Agonized, Paralyzed, Restrained, Stunned, or DeSync

**Defending:** WILL Essence, if unwilling

> **1x —** A second condition is removed.
>
> **2x+ —** All conditions from the Cleanse list are removed as well.

**Silence**\
Binding · TN 8 · TH 3 · Short · Offensive

The vocal cords stop answering. Breath still moves, the jaw still works, and nothing at all comes out. It stops them from speaking. It does not stop them from shooting you.

**Target:** 1 person\
**Effect:** Target cannot speak or make vocal sound. They cannot cast.\
**Defending:** BOD Essence

> **1x —** Duration extends by \[X\] rounds.\
> **2x+ —** Duration extends, and the target is Disoriented.

*Tags: Concentration*

**Tether**

*Binding · TN 8 · TH 3 · Touch · Utility*

It does not stabilize them and does not wake them. It buys one round. Cannot be cast twice on the same target in a scene — the Aether will hold a thread, but it will not hold it twice. Sovereign Soul applies.

**Target:** 1 Dying person within reach

**Effect:** Next Death check is an automatic success

**Defending:** None

> **1x —** The automatic success covers the next two Resets.
>
> **2x+ —** Two Resets are covered, and the target stabilizes, ending Dying.

# **Superior**

*TN 8 · TH 4*

The ceiling of Evocation. Four net Hits leaves a narrow margin even with a strong pool. A Superior spell Manifested is a meaningful event at the table.

## **Elements**

**Focused Lightning**

*Lightning · TN 8 · TH 4 · Short · Offensive · Elemental*

At this scale the spell is pure force rather than arc discharge, and the EMP tag is absent. What it hits, it hits hard.

**Target:** All targets in a line

**Effect:** SP × 2 Damage

**Defending:** Scramble

> **1x —** Line length extends by \[X\]m.
>
> **2x+ —** Line extends, and all targets hit are Shocked and Stunned.

*Tags: AOE*

**Frost Spire**

*Water · TN 8 · TH 4 · Short · Offensive · Physical*

A pillar of ice erupting from the ground. It remains afterward as a physical obstacle until destroyed or melted.

**Target:** Whatever occupies the target point

**Effect:** SP × 2 Damage

**Defending:** Scramble to move clear before emergence

> **1x —** Damage or spire size increases by \[X\].
>
> **2x+ —** Damage increases, the target is Restrained, and the spire shatters when destroyed for ½ SP within \[X\]m.

*Tags: Cold*

**Ice Barrage**

*Water · TN 8 · TH 4 · Short · Offensive · Physical*

Shards driven simultaneously at everyone the caster has decided is a problem.

**Target:** Designated targets, chosen at time of casting

**Effect:** SP Damage distributed as the caster chooses

**Defending:** Dodge, per target

> **1x —** \[X\] additional projectiles, or damage per projectile increases.
>
> **2x —** Additional projectiles, and targets are Restrained.
>
> **3x —** Additional projectiles, and targets are Restrained and Bleeding.

*Tags: Cold*

**Inferno**

*Fire · TN 8 · TH 4 · 5m radius · Offensive · Elemental*

A roaring column of flame. Structures burn. Cover burns. The caster should have a plan for what the room looks like afterward.

**Target:** All targets in the area

**Effect:** SP × 2 Damage

**Defending:** Scramble

> **1x —** Radius increases by \[X\]m.
>
> **2x+ —** Radius increases, and targets who fail are Burning and Agonized.

*Tags: AOE, Fire*

## **Force**

**Aether Lance**

*Shockwave · TN 8 · TH 4 · Short · Offensive · Aether*

A spear of pure Aether that passes through barriers as though they were not there. Armor offers no protection either. This is not an impact.

**Target:** 1 person or object

**Effect:** SP × 2 Damage; ignores armor and barriers

**Defending:** Dodge

>

>
> **2x+ —** Both, and targets are Restrained and Agonized.

Briefly outside physical reality. The re-entry is not always clean.

>

Debris, furniture, loose fittings — whatever the room is willing to give up, delivered at speed.

>
> **2x+ —** Additional strikes, and the target is Prone and Bleeding.

Light intense enough to overwhelm across a wide radius. Anyone with optical augmentation takes it worse.

**Effect:** Area counts as Blind for 1 round

>

They know it happened, they remember it happening, and they were present for all of it. This is not a subtle working and it is not forgiven. Sovereign Soul applies.

## **Soul**

**Return**

*Vitality · TN 8 · TH 4 · Touch · Utility*

The most powerful healing available through Evocation, and still not a resurrection. The target has to be alive when it lands. Sovereign Soul applies.

**Target:** 1 person within reach

**Effect:** Restores SP × 2 Health Levels and ends Dying

**Defending:** WILL Essence, if unwilling

> **1x —** \[X\] additional Health Levels, and one condition is removed.
>
> **2x+ —** Full Health Level restoration, and all conditions from the Cleanse list are removed.

**Vigil**

*Binding · TN 8 · TH 4 · Touch · Utility*

Held, not cast and forgotten. The Arcanist is carrying something, and everything else they do is harder for it. Letting go is always available, and always a decision someone has to say out loud.

**Target:** 1 body dead within \[X\] minutes

**Effect:** Holds the soul in place and arrests decay

**Defending:** None

> **1x —** The ward persists \[X\] minutes after concentration ends.
>
> **2x+ —** The ward persists \[X\] hours after concentration ends, and the body is protected from further harm.

*Tags: Concentration*
